title: Resolution to set property tax class shares for 2027
summary: This resolution certifies to the State Board of Real Property Tax Services the base percentage, current percentage and current base proportion of each of the City's four property tax classes for fiscal year 2027, as required by state law. It caps the increase in Class 1's share at 5% and shifts the excess proportion to Classes 3 and 4, while Class 2 increases 0.4% and Classes 3 and 4 decrease. These figures set the baseline used to determine how much each property class will pay toward the city's tax levy.
